QuestInfo.name: No Gong's Student
QuestInfo.1: No Gong had a student who was struck by a Goblin's spell and started attacking innocent people around the neighborhood, and his name is #bTae Roon#k... the most intelligent student No Gong had ever taught. He is currently in exile out of this town, hoping for the spells to weaken as time goes by...  \n\n No Gong suspected that since he helped Tae Soo out, the spell might be weakening the grip on him, and wanted me to confirm this with #bDo Gong#k.
QuestInfo.2: Do Gong told me he'll do anything to help Tae Roon out. I better go talk to Do Gong once more.

0.0: #bTae Roon#k... He was the most intelligent, dedicated student I ever had. He was a brave young man who'd never turn his back on those in need. The only reason he's wandering around like a loose cannon these days is because of that King Sage Cat.
0.1: Tae Roon had always been a thorn in the King Sage Cat's side, so one day, the King Sage Cat cast a spell on him that made him lose his mind. Once that happened... he started attacking anyone he saw.
0.2: It broke my heart knowing that I couldn't do anything to help him get back on his feet. The only thing I could do to help Tae Roon, who felt miserable about his actions every time he regained consciousness, was to... exile him from this town so he wouldn't injure another person.
0.3: For Tae Roon to help Tae Soo... Maybe the spell on him has weakened over time. If the King Sage Cat's spell can be broken, then Tae Roon will be able to live in the friendly confines of Mu Lung, just like old times. Could you look into it?

yes.0: #bDo Gong#k should be able to determine the strength of the spell casted on Tae Roon even from afar, so please go talk to him immediately.

no.0: I understand that it's a difficult task, but... please reconsider.

1.0: Are you a trainee looking to become Master? Hmmm...No Gong sent you here? He thinks Tae Roon is regaining consciousness?

yes.0: If you're asking me to help with Tae Roon's curse, I can happily do that. He's a student of Mu Lung, first and foremost, even before being No Gong's student. It breaks my heart seeing a fine kid being controlled by the King Sage Cat, and I can't let that go on. Hold on for a second.

npc.0: Haven't you gone to #bDo Gong#k yet? He's right there, so go now.
